# Mediabunny 1.61.6

Unmodified browser bundle from the official npm package `mediabunny@1.61.6`.

- Source: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
- Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/mediabunny/-/mediabunny-1.61.6.tgz
- Package integrity: `sha512-VHEZ53/7jGl4dQ+uOdndsZufFYwEUFWv9UXgvrGun3OapyzoqI9iaPOD7z3xxY/nAttLZBNwswgJzMtGJAquOQ==`
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0; see `mediabunny.LICENSE`.

The standalone HTML embeds this bundle inside a closure and retains its license notice. The source code for this release is available in the npm package and upstream repository. The application uses it for local decoding, H.264 encoding, audio handling and MP4 muxing. No remote service receives video content.
